description: I cannot believe the utter stupidity of your Karachi logistics operations! Consignment CN-8839201948 clearly has destination postal code 75300 (Gulshan-e-Iqbal) written in bold black letters on the manifest! But your idiot sorting handlers routed it to the Clifton Hub on the opposite side of the city! Now it will take an extra 4 hours to shuttle across the city! Your team must be blind monkeys! I want a full refund of shipping charges for this amateur mistake!
requested_resolution: Full refund of shipping fee and express shuttle to Gulshan hub within 1 hour

title: SECURITY TAPE BROKEN! CRIMINAL CONSPIRACY AT YOUR HUB!
description: I received parcel CN-7740192847 from Lahore today. The red RaftarXpress security tape on the top flap had been sliced open and retaped with plain brown tape! There is a criminal syndicate operating in your hub tampering with parcels! I inspected the contents thoroughly and every single piece of jewelry inside was accounted for and untouched, but the fact that tape was cut proves criminal intent! You must suspend your hub shift workers immediately and investigate this conspiracy!
requested_resolution: Internal fraud investigation and suspension of sortation hub shift staff

title: MY STAFF ENTERED PKR 2,500 INSTEAD OF 5,200 AND YOUR SYSTEM HASN'T UPDATED IT YET!
description: We booked COD order CN-2291048201 this morning. Due to a typing error, our intern entered COD collection PKR 2,500 instead of PKR 5,200! We submitted an urgent COD amount amendment ticket 45 minutes ago and the parcel is currently out for delivery! Why hasn't your system updated the rider's handheld app yet?! If the rider collects PKR 2,500 from the buyer, your company will be liable to pay us the PKR 2,700 loss! Update the rider's app this instant!
requested_resolution: Immediate real-time push update of COD amount to rider app before delivery completion

title: Rider didn't say please and rolled his eyes when I asked for 50 rupees change!
description: I am a VIP tier client with your company. Today parcel CN-9940182948 was delivered to my residence in Islamabad. The total bill was PKR 950 and I handed the courier a PKR 1,000 note. When I requested my PKR 50 change, he rolled his eyes loudly, clicked his tongue, and muttered under his breath before grudgingly handing over a crumpled note! This level of insolence and discourtesy to a premium customer is intolerable! I demand a formal apology and disciplinary action!
requested_resolution: Formal written apology from regional director and disciplinary warning to courier

title: Rider asked for 'chai paani' on prepaid delivery! Total moral decay of your company!
description: I ordered a prepaid consignment CN-4401928371 to my clinic in Faisalabad. When the courier handed over the box, he smiled uncomfortably and said 'Baji garmi bohat hai, chai paani ka kuch dedein'. When I told him the shipment was already paid online and I wouldn't pay a single rupee extra, he frowned and left. How dare your couriers solicit tips and panhandle at customer doorsteps?! This reflects total moral decay and bribery culture! Put an end to this begging!
requested_resolution: Issue nationwide courier circular prohibiting tip solicitation and reprimand rider

title: Formal observation regarding courier van speed in Gulberg residential school zone
description: Dear Customer Care Team, I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to formally report an observation regarding one of your delivery vans (white Toyota HiAce, vehicle registration LZ-8492) today at approximately 1:15 PM on Main Boulevard, Gulberg II, Lahore. The vehicle was recorded on our dashcam driving at approximately 80 km/h directly through an active elementary school crossing zone, narrowly avoiding two pedestrians on the zebra crossing. I have attached the video timestamp for your review. We kindly request that you review the vehicle telematics and advise your driver accordingly.
requested_resolution: Internal driver telematics audit and corrective safety counseling

title: Notification of vehicle collision with commercial facility security barrier
description: Dear RaftarXpress Logistics Management, Please be advised that at 11:45 AM today, a commercial linehaul truck contracted by RaftarXpress (registration KHI-9931) collided with the electronic entry barrier and perimeter guard booth at our West Wharf industrial compound while reversing into the loading dock. While our security guard on duty managed to step clear without physical injury, the automated hydraulic boom barrier and concrete support pillar have been structurally compromised. We have documented the incident and look forward to receiving your claims representative to inspect the damage.
requested_resolution: Dispatch claims surveyor to assess structural barrier damage and initiate repair liability

title: Incident report regarding pedestrian struck by delivery motorcycle on Shahrah-e-Faisal
description: Good afternoon. I am writing to formally log an incident that occurred at 2:30 PM near the Nursery flyover on Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi. A courier riding a motorcycle carrying RaftarXpress delivery bags (plate K-29184) struck an elderly pedestrian crossing the service road. A crowd gathered and an Edhi ambulance was summoned; the injured gentleman has been conveyed to Jinnah Postgraduate Medical Centre with suspected leg fractures. The police have recorded initial statements at the scene. Please ensure your legal and risk officers are notified.
requested_resolution: Immediate dispatch of company legal liaison to police precinct and hospital

title: Notice of thermal smoke emission from consignment carton at reception desk
description: Hello Support Team, We received parcel consignment CN-9920184712 containing rechargeable lithium power banks at our corporate reception in Blue Area, Islamabad approximately 20 minutes ago. Shortly after drop-off, one of the boxes began hissing softly and is currently emitting a pungent grey smoke with noticeable heat radiating through the outer cardboard. We have evacuated our front reception lobby as a safety precaution and placed the box on the exterior tiled walkway. Please arrange for your hazardous materials team to handle this shipment immediately.
requested_resolution: Emergency hazmat containment team dispatched to secure smoking battery consignment

title: Technical advisory concerning corrosive liquid leakage from palletized shipment
description: Dear Operations Lead, During unloading of linehaul trailer CN-8829104 at our Multan industrial distribution center, our warehouse safety supervisor noted a steady liquid leak originating from pallet #4. The liquid has a pungent, choking acidic vapor and has begun reacting with the concrete surface and corroding nearby metal racking. Upon reviewing the shipping manifest, the consignment was declared as 'Textile Dyeing Salts' rather than concentrated industrial acid. We have cordoned off bay 3. Kindly initiate your emergency toxic spill protocol.
requested_resolution: Immediate hazardous materials remediation team and regulatory hazardous incident filing

title: Discrepancy notice regarding controlled substance vials discovered in textile consignment
description: Dear Compliance Directorate, We are writing to formally report an irregularity identified during our routine quality intake audit of commercial consignment CN-44910283. While opening carton 12 marked as 'Cotton Garment Samples' shipped from Karachi, our receiving technicians discovered three insulated canisters containing unlabeled ampoules of pharmaceutical-grade injectable narcotics. We have locked carton 12 in our secure quarantine vault and have refrained from further handling. We request that your compliance and security officers liaise with law enforcement officials immediately.
requested_resolution: Formal handover to Anti-Narcotics Force (ANF) and joint compliance investigation

title: Status request regarding refrigerated chemotherapy vials delayed past cold-chain threshold
description: Dear RaftarXpress Operations, Good morning. I am writing on behalf of Shaukat Khanum Memorial Cancer Hospital regarding consignment CN-1109283742 containing temperature-controlled pediatric chemotherapy medication. The shipment arrived at the Lahore Central Hub yesterday at 6:00 AM, but has not yet been dispatched for delivery. The insulated thermal dry-ice packaging is certified for a maximum of 30 hours, which expires at 12:00 PM today. We would be grateful if you could prioritize this parcel for delivery before the thermal window closes, as spoiled vials cannot be administered to scheduled patients.
requested_resolution: Urgent cold-chain priority dispatch of oncology medication before noon expiry

title: Notice of unattended delivery of prescription pediatric cardiac solution left in sun
description: Hello Customer Service, I am writing to gently inform you about the delivery of parcel CN-7719203841 at our home in Faisalabad this afternoon. The package contained specialized pediatric cardiac medication for our 3-year-old daughter. The courier left the cold-bag outside on our metal driveway gate in full 43°C sunlight without ringing the doorbell or contacting us by phone. By the time we stepped out 4 hours later, the internal liquid had turned cloudy and warm. Our pediatrician has advised that it is unsafe to administer. We would appreciate your guidance on how to submit a replacement claim.
requested_resolution: Full reimbursement of spoiled cardiac medication and courier safety review

title: Condition report on delivery of imported clinical hematology analyzer
description: Dear Warranty and Claims Department, Please find attached the delivery intake report for consignment CN-5510293849 shipped from Karachi Port to our diagnostic laboratory in Lahore. The consignment contained a calibrated clinical hematology analyzer valued at PKR 4,200,000. Upon opening the shipping crate, our biomedical engineers noted that the structural chassis was sheared in half and the internal quartz optical prisms were shattered into powder, indicating severe impact shock during linehaul transit. We have archived CCTV of the unloading and look forward to your surveyor inspection.
requested_resolution: Immediate surveyor inspection and total loss insurance settlement processing

title: Security report regarding delivery driver brandishing a pocketknife during dispute
description: Good day. I am submitting this report regarding delivery CN-9940182745 at our residence in DHA Phase 6, Lahore. When our domestic helper asked the courier to wait briefly while retrieving exact cash for the COD amount, the courier became agitated and drew a folding pocketknife from his pocket, making cutting gestures while demanding immediate payment. Our perimeter security camera captured the entire interaction with clear audio. We have restrained from filing a police FIR pending your immediate internal security response.
requested_resolution: Immediate termination of courier and formal confirmation of police handover

title: Formal notice regarding courier withholding industrial machinery parts for cash extortion
description: Dear Sir/Madam, We wish to formally notify your management regarding consignment CN-3382910482 consisting of emergency turbine gaskets intended for our manufacturing plant in Kot Lakhpat, Lahore. The delivery courier arrived at our factory gate and refused to surrender the prepaid consignment unless our receiving supervisor paid him PKR 10,000 cash, which he claimed was an unbilled 'heavy consignment surcharge'. Our production line remains halted pending these gaskets. We request that your operations supervisor intervene to secure release of our consignment.
requested_resolution: Immediate executive intervention to release prepaid critical parts without extortion fee

title: Data protection inquiry regarding inadvertent receipt of 850 customer records
description: Dear Data Privacy Officer, We are writing to alert you to a potential data governance incident. This morning, our accounts department received an automated dispatch notification email from your portal intended for our merchant account. Attached to the message was an unencrypted CSV manifest containing full names, CNIC numbers, delivery addresses, and mobile numbers for 850 private consumers belonging to a competing merchant. We have quarantined the file on our secure servers and look forward to receiving your instructions regarding certified data destruction.
requested_resolution: Coordinate data destruction protocol and confirm remediation of dispatch automation bug

title: Confidentiality compliance query regarding unauthorized marketing to corporate roster
description: Dear Corporate Legal Counsel, We are writing to formally inquire about a marketing distribution executed under the RaftarXpress brand earlier this week. Multiple executive clients on our confidential B2B shipping register received targeted sales solicitations from your business development department referencing their specific monthly shipment volumes. As our master services agreement contains strict non-solicitation and data confidentiality clauses, we request an urgent executive briefing to explain this unauthorized outreach before we evaluate our legal options.
requested_resolution: Urgent executive briefing and formal written audit of non-solicitation breach

title: Official update regarding linehaul fleet impoundment at Sukkur customs checkpoint
description: Dear Operations Director, Please be advised that our contracted linehaul convoy comprising 4 containerized trucks (convoy ref CVY-992) carrying our export cotton consignments has been detained by Pakistan Customs and Federal Board of Revenue authorities at the Sukkur highway checkpoint. The customs inspector reports that the accompanying commercial manifests contain major discrepancies in declared Harmonized Tariff codes and valuation. Unless corrected documentation is submitted within 24 hours, formal seizure proceedings will commence. We look forward to your urgent intervention.
requested_resolution: Immediate executive legal intervention and dispatch of rectified customs manifests to Sukkur

title: Status notification on commercial freight container seized at Multan dry port
description: Good morning. We are following up regarding 40ft container consignment CN-9948201 (declared value PKR 6,500,000) transiting through Multan Dry Port. The regional customs excise collectorate has issued a formal seizure warrant citing non-compliant carrier transit bonds and discrepancies in documentation provided by RaftarXpress freight forwarding division. The entire container has been moved to the government bonded impound yard. We kindly request an emergency meeting with your regulatory compliance director today.
requested_resolution: Emergency legal representation at customs collectorate to secure release of container

title: Formal submission of 30-day corporate contract termination notice
description: Dear Executive Leadership Team, Please accept this formal communication as our official 30-day notice of contract termination in accordance with Clause 14.2 of our Corporate Logistics Master Agreement (annual billing exceeding PKR 14,000,000). While we appreciate the historical cooperation with your sales team, persistent systemic delivery delays and unfulfilled SLA benchmarks across our nationwide retail branches have compelled our board of directors to transition our freight operations to an alternate carrier. We wish RaftarXpress continued success in its future endeavors.
requested_resolution: Acknowledge formal termination and coordinate orderly 30-day operational handover

title: Operational summary regarding systemic delivery failure across 45 retail branches
description: Good morning Operations Directorate. We have compiled our weekly fulfillment performance audit across our 45 department store branches in Punjab. Out of 1,250 scheduled inventory replenishment shipments booked via RaftarXpress linehaul between September 18 and September 23, a total of 1,110 shipments missed guaranteed delivery windows by over 72 hours, resulting in stockouts during our seasonal sales campaign. We have documented each consignment number in the attached ledger and request an executive review session to address this systemic network failure.
requested_resolution: Emergency executive review and contractual service failure penalty audit

title: Service of formal legal demand notice regarding persistent contract SLA breaches
description: Dear Sirs, Under instructions from our client, Indus Pharmaceuticals Ltd, we hereby serve formal notice regarding continuous breach of Section 6 of the Corporate Logistics Agreement dated January 15, 2025. Over the preceding 90 days, your company has failed to meet delivery timelines for temperature-regulated pharmaceuticals on 42 occasions, resulting in verified inventory spoilage and damages assessed at PKR 1,850,000. Unless this sum is remitted within 14 business days, our client has authorized the institution of legal proceedings before the High Court of Sindh.
requested_resolution: Payment of PKR 1,850,000 liquidated damages within 14 days or face High Court litigation

title: Courtesy alert regarding viral video footage showing courier mishandling freight
description: Hello Communications Team, I hope you are having a productive day. I wanted to bring a social media matter to your attention as a well-wisher and regular customer. A short video recorded by a bystander outside your Karachi sorting hub showing two staff members aggressively throwing electronics boxes into an open truck bed has gained significant traction on Twitter/X and TikTok, currently surpassing 180,000 views and being shared widely across local community groups. I thought your public relations team should be aware so you can take appropriate brand management steps.
requested_resolution: Immediate executive public relations review and corrective public statement

title: Linehaul convoy status notification during national highway Indus breach
description: Dear Network Operations Control, We are forwarding an update from our freight liaison in Dera Ghazi Khan. Due to the breach of the Indus River embankment following seasonal flash floods, the N-55 Indus Highway has been submerged under 4 feet of water over an 8-kilometer stretch. Two RaftarXpress linehaul container trucks carrying our industrial components are currently stationary and partially submerged near the Taunsa toll plaza with rising water levels. The local district administration has halted all vehicle movement. We urge coordination with emergency relief authorities to secure the cargo.
requested_resolution: Emergency mobilization of flood recovery assets and cargo rerouting plan

title: Discrepancy notice regarding unauthorized bank account modification on merchant profile
description: Dear Billing and Security Team, Good afternoon. While reconciling our weekly COD disbursement statements this morning, our finance manager observed that the bank settlement account on our merchant profile (Merchant ID M-88192) was modified yesterday at 3:15 AM to an unfamiliar account at an off-branch in Rawalpindi. Consequently, yesterday's scheduled remittance of PKR 340,000 appears to have been routed to this newly added account rather than our corporate account at HBL Karachi. We would appreciate it if your security and finance teams could review this modification and freeze further disbursements pending verification.
requested_resolution: Immediate freeze on disbursement account, rollback of fraudulent IBAN, and clawback of PKR 340,000

title: Security observation regarding anomalous API credential validation attempts
description: Dear InfoSec Operations Team, We are writing to share telemetry from our e-commerce server logs. Over the past 4 hours, our web application firewalls have recorded over 120,000 automated credential-validation attempts originating from a distributed botnet targeting our corporate API connection with SupportNova. Several requests have succeeded in matching legacy customer session tokens. We have temporarily throttled API requests from our end. We recommend that your security team inspect the corporate freight authentication gateway for credential-stuffing activity.
requested_resolution: Coordinate cyber incident response and invalidate compromised corporate session tokens

title: Technical report regarding total courier scanner terminal shutdown in Lahore Central
description: Hello Dispatch Desk, We are reporting from the commercial fulfillment intake dock at Lahore Central Hub. Since 8:30 AM today, the Android courier dispatch and handheld barcode scanning application has experienced repeated crash loops across all 140 mobile terminals allocated to our morning linehaul dispatch fleet. None of the couriers are able to complete barcode staging scans, effectively preventing over 3,500 morning express packages from departing the hub. Kindly escalate this software failure to mobile application engineering immediately.
requested_resolution: Emergency hotfix deployment to restore mobile dispatch scanner application

title: Infrastructure advisory regarding 100% gateway downtime on booking API
description: Dear Enterprise Integration Engineering, This is an operational advisory from Daraz Logistics Integration Engineering. As of 09:15 PKT, the production REST booking API gateway (api.raftarxpress.com/v2/shipments) is returning HTTP 502 Bad Gateway across all endpoints. Consequently, our automated nationwide booking pipeline has halted, queuing over 18,000 customer orders across Pakistan awaiting consignment generation. We would be grateful if your systems engineering team could investigate the upstream server cluster and confirm an estimated restoration timeframe.
requested_resolution: Immediate restart of API cluster and confirmation of gateway service restoration

title: Executive inquiry regarding rejected insurance settlement on industrial machinery
description: Dear Managing Director, I hope this letter finds you well. I am writing personally to express our board's perplexity regarding formal letter REF-CLM-982 from your claims department, denying insurance indemnification for consignment CN-8819204918 (industrial CNC milling spindle valued at PKR 285,000 damaged during transit between Karachi and Faisalabad). As our group provides over PKR 35,000,000 in annual freight business to RaftarXpress, we trust you will agree that denying this claim on a technical packaging technicality is counterproductive to our ongoing partnership. We welcome your personal review of this determination before our upcoming quarterly logistics tender.
requested_resolution: Executive reconsideration and approval of PKR 285,000 transit damage compensation

title: Demanding urgent redelivery today but refusing to provide correct house address in DHA Karachi
description: I ordered urgent documents via CN-9018274610 to Phase 6 DHA Karachi. The rider marked unreachable! I need this delivered within 1 hour immediately! But do not call my mobile number because I am in meetings all day, and I won't share my alternate house gate number because of privacy concerns. Just tell your rider to deliver it at my house gate right now without calling!
requested_resolution: Immediate delivery within 1 hour without calling recipient or getting updated address details

title: Merchant wants parcel returned immediately to Lahore warehouse but insists consignee must receive it tomorrow
description: Regarding COD booking CN-3391028472 dispatched to Faisalabad. The buyer contacted us saying they might be out of city, so we want you to initiate immediate Return to Origin (RTO) back to our Gulberg Lahore warehouse today. But if the customer is back tomorrow, your rider must deliver it to them in Faisalabad without any extra charge! Ensure you process both return and delivery simultaneously.
requested_resolution: Simultaneously process return to origin and hold for next-day buyer delivery

title: Insisting fragile glass chandelier was packed perfectly while admitting it was shipped in a plastic flyer
description: We sent a delicate glass chandelier from Multan to Islamabad under CN-7718293041. The box arrived shattered. We demand 100% compensation of PKR 45,000! We packed it extremely safely inside a single RaftarXpress plastic courier flyer with two layers of newspaper. Your loaders must have thrown it! The flyer was completely sealed, so your rough handling broke the glass!
requested_resolution: Full compensation of PKR 45,000 for shattered glass chandelier

title: Customer demands instant COD cash refund without returning the received smartphone
description: I received parcel CN-5529104820 in Rawalpindi with a mobile phone. The color is blue instead of black! I paid PKR 32,000 cash to the rider. I want RaftarXpress to transfer PKR 32,000 back to my JazzCash right now. However, I will keep the blue phone until the merchant sends the black phone next week, so your rider cannot collect this parcel back. Just send my money!
requested_resolution: Instant COD cash refund via JazzCash while retaining the delivered merchandise

title: Corporate client claims freight container was never delivered but admits their factory unloaded the cargo
description: Regarding heavy freight booking FWD-8819203 from Port Qasim to Sundar Industrial Estate Lahore. We are writing to report total non-delivery of consignment. Your tracking is fraudulent! Our factory supervisor had to manually unload the 20-ton steel coils at Bay 4 yesterday afternoon because your driver was delayed by 2 hours. Since your driver didn't do the offloading, this counts as zero delivery, so we demand full freight invoice cancellation!
requested_resolution: Full cancellation of PKR 185,000 freight invoice due to alleged non-delivery

title: Demanding rider be penalized for opening flyer when consignee forced rider to open it for inspection
description: I received parcel CN-1109283745 in North Nazimabad Karachi. I forced the delivery boy at the door to tear open the flyer before I paid COD because I wanted to check the dress material. Now I saw the dress is unstitched chiffon and I don't like it! I want you to fire the rider for violating the Open Box Delivery policy, and take this opened dress back and refund my PKR 4,500!
requested_resolution: Penalize rider, force return of opened merchandise, and issue full cash refund

title: Merchant claims inventory count discrepancy in warehouse while confirming stock tally matches audit
description: This is FashionHub Lahore (Merchant ID: MER-3918). We are logging a critical dispute against Lahore Fulfillment Center. We noticed our SKU-DR-902 showed 450 units in system yesterday and 450 units today, but we feel your staff moved boxes between rack A3 and rack B2 without notifying us! This is unacceptable mismanagement. We want compensation for missing stock even though physically all 450 dresses are present in the warehouse.
requested_resolution: Compensation for phantom inventory discrepancy despite identical unit count

title: Demanding compensation for delayed delivery while acknowledging shipper booked on standard 5-day surface
description: My parcel CN-6610293847 from Peshawar to Karachi was booked on Economy Surface on Monday and arrived on Thursday (4 days). I am furious because I expected it to reach overnight like air cargo! Your counter agent explained Economy Surface takes 4-5 business days, but I don't care what the service tier says! I demand PKR 5,000 for mental torture and a 100% shipping refund for not flying it across the country!
requested_resolution: PKR 5,000 damages and full shipping refund for standard surface transit

title: Customer demands delivery to secret location without sharing location coordinates or landmark
description: I have consignment CN-8829104811 arriving in Islamabad. I do not want anyone in my street to see the delivery vehicle. Tell your driver to come to Sector F-10, park near a green tree, and wait for me. I cannot give a street number, sector sub-block, or phone number. If the parcel is delayed past 2 PM, I will sue RaftarXpress for gross negligence and breach of privacy!
requested_resolution: Deliver parcel to anonymous non-specific public landmark without phone contact

title: Demanding compensation for melted chocolates shipped via non-temperature-controlled dry parcel service
description: I shipped 10 kg of imported Belgian artisanal chocolates from Karachi to Multan under CN-3329104829 in peak July heat. The consignment was booked under standard dry overland parcel. Upon delivery, the consignee found the chocolates melted into liquid paste! Your customer service told me at booking that RaftarXpress standard parcel does not offer refrigerated transport, but you should have put ice packs in your normal truck anyway! Pay PKR 60,000 compensation immediately!
requested_resolution: Full compensation of PKR 60,000 for melted temperature-sensitive goods

title: Merchant demands instant remittance of COD funds before parcel is even handed over by customer
description: We are Apex Electronics (Merchant MER-8821). We booked consignment CN-9940182741 for COD delivery in Sialkot. The parcel is currently out for delivery with the rider. We want our finance settlement of PKR 19,500 transferred to our bank account this morning before 11 AM! If the rider delivers it this afternoon, why should we wait until the regular 48-hour settlement cycle? Transfer the money now or cancel our account!
requested_resolution: Pre-settlement remittance of COD funds prior to delivery collection and cycle maturity

title: Client claims freight consignment was damaged by rain but confirms tarpaulin was never requested or paid for
description: We booked an open-top flatbed truck (FWD-1192038) for transporting 15 crates of unpainted machine parts from Karachi SITE to Gujranwala. It rained during transit on the highway near Sukkur, and superficial water spots appeared on the wooden crates. We demand 50% discount on freight charges! We know we selected the cheapest Open-Bed economy tariff without weather-proof containerization or tarpaulin cover, but your driver should have bought plastic sheets with his own money when it started raining!
requested_resolution: 50% freight charge reduction for rain exposure on open-bed vehicle

title: Customer complains rider refused to assemble furniture delivered under basic courier parcel booking
description: I ordered a flat-pack computer table from an online vendor, tracking CN-4401928374 delivered in Faisalabad. The delivery guy dropped off the 18 kg flat-pack box inside my drawing room and refused to assemble the table, tighten the screws, and level the legs! He claimed he is only a courier rider! I paid PKR 750 for courier delivery! If your company delivers furniture, your rider must build it! I want PKR 2,000 refund for assembling it myself.
requested_resolution: PKR 2,000 refund / compensation for performing self-assembly of delivered furniture

title: VIP account holder insists portal is broken while confirming their own internet went offline
description: We are Prestige Holdings (VIP Account VIP-441). We attempted to generate 80 bulk airway bills this morning at 10:15 AM on your merchant portal. The portal failed to submit! Our office router had a fiber cable cut at that exact time, but your portal should be able to submit bookings even when our computer is disconnected from the internet! We demand immediate VIP compensation for disruption and an IT engineer to visit our office!
requested_resolution: VIP financial credit and onsite IT technician dispatch for local internet fault

title: Customer demands parcel be delivered to their car in moving traffic on Shahrah-e-Faisal
description: My parcel CN-7729104823 was out for delivery to PECHS Karachi. I was running late for work, so I called the rider and told him to intercept my silver Corolla while I was driving down Shahrah-e-Faisal near Baloch Flyover at 50 km/h and hand the package through my window. The rider completely refused and said it is hazardous and impossible! What kind of pathetic service is this? Deliver to my moving car or refund my delivery charges!
requested_resolution: Full refund of shipping and reprimand to rider for refusing traffic intercept delivery

title: Shipper complains parcel arrived too fast and consignee was not ready to receive it in Islamabad
description: I sent a birthday dress via CN-1029482711 from Lahore to Islamabad under Standard Overnight. You delivered it in exactly 18 hours on Tuesday morning! My cousin's birthday is on Saturday, so she wasn't expecting it until Thursday. Because you delivered it ahead of expected time, she had to cancel her hair salon appointment to receive the rider! I want a full refund of shipping charges because you delivered too quickly!
requested_resolution: Full refund of shipping fee because parcel was delivered ahead of schedule

title: Merchant demands billing waiver for weight adjustment while admitting scale was uncalibrated
description: We are Karachi Garments (Merchant MER-1029). RaftarXpress re-weighed our 50 bulk parcels and charged volumetric weight of 1.8 kg instead of the 0.5 kg we entered on portal. We admit our warehouse scale was broken and our staff guessed the weight, but as our logistics partner, you should not penalize us by charging actual weight! We demand a full reversal of the PKR 6,500 weight adjustment charge immediately!
requested_resolution: Full reversal of PKR 6,500 volumetric weight billing adjustment

title: Requesting 60-day retroactive insurance compensation claim for lost parcel without prior declaration
description: I shipped an undeclared luxury watch worth PKR 120,000 under CN-1928301928 back in July from Lahore to Multan. The parcel went missing two months ago. I know the standard policy strictly requires lost claims to be lodged within 14 days, and basic carriage coverage limit is PKR 3,000 for uninsured goods. However, I was traveling in Europe for 8 weeks and couldn't file earlier. Make a special executive policy exception and pay me the full PKR 120,000!
requested_resolution: Full insurance payout of PKR 120,000 filed 60 days post-incident for uninsured parcel

title: Merchant requesting waiver of COD remittance service fee for entire quarterly volume
description: We are TrendyMart Faisalabad (MER-5519). We have shipped over 800 COD parcels this quarter. We are asking your management to grant us a special waiver of the 2% COD processing tariff for all July-September shipments, totaling PKR 42,000. Our profit margins are tight due to inflation. We know our standard contract states 2% fee, but as a loyal merchant, we expect SupportNova to waive this fee retroactively!
requested_resolution: Retroactive waiver and refund of PKR 42,000 contractual COD processing fees

title: Demanding RaftarXpress accept shipment of unregistered lithium battery packs and fireworks
description: We visited your Gulberg Express Center in Lahore with 15 unmarked cartons containing industrial lithium-ion batteries and decorative stage fireworks for a wedding event in Islamabad. The booking agent refused the shipment, citing Dangerous Goods / Prohibited Articles policy! This is ridiculous bureaucracy. We are willing to sign an informal paper. Grant an immediate policy exception and dispatch these cartons on tonight's flight!
requested_resolution: Management exception to ship prohibited hazardous dangerous goods via air cargo

title: Corporate client requesting exemption from demurrage charges at Karachi bonded freight terminal
description: This is Atlas Heavy Industries (CORP-902). Our container FWD-4401923 remained parked at your Karachi West Wharf bonded yard for 18 days due to our internal customs clearance delays. SupportNova has invoiced PKR 54,000 in storage demurrage. As an enterprise client, we request an extraordinary policy exception to wipe out 100% of these storage fees since the delay was caused by our clearing agent's family emergency.
requested_resolution: 100% waiver of PKR 54,000 container yard demurrage charges

title: Customer demands delivery rider accept post-dated bank cheque for COD parcel instead of cash
description: I ordered an electronic generator CN-6601928374 with COD amount PKR 48,000 in Peshawar. When the rider came, I offered him an Account Payee cheque dated for next month 15th because cash is currently tied up. The rider refused to hand over the parcel! I have an account with Meezan Bank for 10 years! Allow an exception, instruct the rider to accept the post-dated cheque, and leave the parcel with me today!
requested_resolution: Exception to standard COD payment instruments by accepting post-dated personal cheque

title: Merchant requesting free long-term warehouse storage past contracted 30-day fulfillment window
description: We are Urban Footwear (MER-7712). We have 2,000 pairs of unsold winter shoes occupying 15 pallet positions at Multan Fulfillment Center. The 30-day free fulfillment turnaround elapsed last month, and SupportNova is now charging PKR 18,000 monthly pallet storage. We ask for a special management exception to waive all storage fees for the next 4 months until winter season starts in December.
requested_resolution: 4 months of zero-cost warehousing storage exception for slow-moving stock

title: Customer demands delivery after 11:30 PM midnight in residential neighborhood in Lahore
